title: SM AC11C
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time synchronous machine AC11C excitation system including an automatic voltage regulator and an exciter, 10 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Initial field voltage, Efd0 (pu)} sets the initial output voltage, {Initial terminal voltage, Vt0 (pu)}, {Initial terminal current, It0 (pu)}, {Resistive component of load compensation, R_C (pu)} sets the compensation resistance, {Reactance component of load compensation, X_C (pu)} sets the compensation reactance, {Regulator input filter time constant, T_R (s)} sets the regulator time constant, {Voltage regulator proportional gain, K_PA (pu)} sets the proportional gain of voltage regulator, {Voltage regulator integral time constant, T_IA (s)} sets the integral time constant of voltage, {UEL regulator proportional gain, K_PU (pu)} sets the proportional gain of UEL regulator, {UEL regulator integral time constant, T_IU (s)} sets the integral time constant of UEL regulator, {Voltage and UEL regulator derivative gain, K_B (pu)} sets the derivative gain of voltage and UEL, {Time constant for derivative element, T_B (s)}, {OEL regulator proportional gain, K_PO (pu)} sets the proportional gain of OEL regulator, {OEL regulator integral time constant, T_IO (s)} sets the integral time constant of OEL regulator, {Maximum regulator output, V_Rmax (pu)}, {Minimum regulator output, V_Rmin (pu)}, {Maximum PSS regulator output, V_RSmax (pu)}, {Minimum PSS regulator output, V_RSmin (pu)}, {Maximum exciter output, V_Amax (pu)}, {Minimum exciter output, V_Amin (pu)}, {Alternate PSS input locations (V_S)} sets the pSS input location Output of AVR, {Alternate OEL input locations (V_OEL)} sets the oEL input location Take-over at voltage, {Alternate UEL input locations (V_UEL)} sets the uEL input location Take-over at voltage, {Alternate SCL input locations (V_SCL)} sets the sCL input location Take-over at voltage, {Exciter field proportional constant, K_E (pu)} sets the exciter field gain, {Exciter field time constant, T_E (s)}, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C (pu)}, {Demagnetizing factor, function of exciter alternator reactances, K_D (pu)} sets the demagnetization factor, {Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_1), E_1 (pu)} sets the first saturation output voltage, {Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_1, S_E(E_1) (1)} sets the first saturation lookup voltage, {Exciter output voltage for saturation factor S_E(E_2), E_2 (pu)} sets the second saturation output voltage, {Exciter saturation factor at exciter output voltage E_2, S_E(E_2) (1)} sets the second saturation lookup voltage, {Maximum exciter field current, V_FEmax (pu)} sets the exciter upper limit, {Minimum exciter output limit, V_Emin (pu)} sets the exciter lower limit, {Potential circuit (voltage) gain coefficient, K_P (pu)} sets the potential circuit gain coefficient, {Potential circuit phase angle (degrees)}, {Potential circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I (pu)} sets the potential circuit current gain coefficient, {Reactance associated with potential source, X_L (pu)}, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C1 (pu)}, {Power source selector SW1} sets the power source selector Position B: power source independent of the terminal, {Maximum available exciter voltage, V_B1max (pu)} sets the maximum available exciter field voltage, {Rectifier loading factor proportional to commutating reactance, K_C2 (pu)}, {Additive potential circuit (current) gain coefficient, K_I2 (pu)} sets the additive circuit current gain coefficient, {Maximum available exciter voltage, V_B2max (pu)}, {Additive independent source, K_BOOST (pu)} and {Reference value for applying additive (boost) circuit, V_BOOST (pu)} sets the reference value for applying boost circuit. Values come from the instance.
